info.title: XCP DEX Market Data API
info.description: Aggregator-facing market data for the Counterparty DEX (XCP DEX). CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap use the explicit market allowlist in /catalog/pairs. DefiLlama volume is venue-wide across every BTC- or XCP-quoted market that can be priced defensibly. Completed Counterparty order-book settlements, AMM pool fills, and BTC-denominated dispenser executions are counted once; pending BTC order matches and PSBT/UTXO swaps are excluded. Dispenser quote volume and prices are protocol-priced notional (dispensed quantity x the dispenser's satoshirate-derived unit price), never the gross Bitcoin payment, which can be shared across multiple dispensers and can include overpayment. Methodology: https://xcpdex.com/methodology

get.description: Markets currently surfaced by the feed. The universe is a fixed allowlist; allowlisted pairs with no completed settlement ever are omitted here and from tickers (see /catalog/pairs for the full allowlist with status). Cache-Control: 300s.

The 24h window is rolling (request time minus 24 hours through request time), not a UTC calendar day. Inclusion is governed by the Bitcoin block time of the completed settlement. high/low are calculated from completed settlements only; when no settlement occurred in the window they fall back to last_price and volumes are "0.00000000". bid/ask are the best currently executable levels (order-book bids; order-book asks merged with open dispenser offers on BTC-quoted pairs); null when that side has no executable level. An open bid or ask is never promoted into last_price. Cache-Control: 60s.

Bids sorted descending, asks ascending, aggregated by price level, executable remaining quantities only. On BTC-quoted pairs, open dispensers (escrow remaining, protocol price) are merged into the ask side - dispensers contribute asks, never bids. Cache-Control: 60s.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Total entries across both sides. 0 or absent = full depth, capped at 500 levels per side.

get.description: Newest first. No cursor: page a window by narrowing end_time below the oldest trade_timestamp already received and de-duplicating on trade_id. Dispenser executions always report type=buy (the payer acquires the base asset). A nonzero execution is never published with a zero price; such rows are dropped and logged (PRICE_QUANTIZATION_LOSS).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Return only one side. Response contains only the requested key when set.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 0 = full history, capped at 1000 rows per response.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound, unix SECONDS (per CoinGecko's spec); millisecond values are also accepted and detected automatically.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound, unix SECONDS; millisecond values are also accepted and detected automatically.

get.description: Identical underlying dataset to /coingecko/tickers (the production reconciliation gate enforces field-level equality). type is always "spot". Cache-Control: 60s.

Executed spot volume for an arbitrary finalized [start, end) window, grouped by BTC/XCP quote asset and settlement source. Includes every non-hidden base asset traded against BTC or XCP; this endpoint does not use the CoinGecko/CMC pair allowlist. BTC/XCP are returned as native quote balances so DefiLlama prices them at the requested period. A window not yet finalized by the indexer returns 503 instead of a placeholder zero. Historical responses receive long-lived shared-cache headers.

parameters.name: end_timestamp
parameters.description: Exclusive window end, unix seconds. The maximum window is 31 days.

503.description: The indexer has not finalized the requested end timestamp; retry later.

get.description: The complete market allowlist with per-asset disambiguation (protocol, divisibility, longname, canonical explorer URL) and data-driven execution_sources: "pool" appears only on pairs with a live AMM pool, "dispenser" only on BTC-quoted pairs. status: active (completed fill within 90 days), stale (priced, no recent fill), inactive (never priced; omitted from tickers). Cache-Control: 300s.

tickerId.name: ticker_id
tickerId.description: BASE_QUOTE, e.g. XCP_BTC. Valid values are the allowlist in /catalog/pairs.

UnknownTicker.description: Syntactically valid ticker_id that is not in the market allowlist.

TickerId.description: BASE_QUOTE. Counterparty asset names never contain underscores, so the split is unambiguous.

QuantityString.description: Asset quantity or volume as a fixed 8-decimal string (Counterparty divisible-asset precision).

PriceString.description: Unit price as a full-precision, non-scientific decimal string. Sub-satoshi unit prices are real on this venue (1 satoshi for 1,000 units = 0.00000000001), so prices are NOT truncated to 8 decimals. Trailing zeros are trimmed.

TimestampMs.description: UTC milliseconds since epoch. Settlement timestamps are the Bitcoin block time of the confirming block.

TradeId.description: Permanent unique integer, namespaced by settlement source: source_id x 8 + code, where code 0 = order-book settlement, 1 = AMM pool fill, 2 = dispenser execution, 3 = reserved for PSBT/UTXO swaps. Rows only ever append under protocol-derived unique keys, so an ID never changes or repeats.

pool_id.description: Counterparty LP asset name for markets with an AMM pool. Orderbook-only markets have no LP asset and use their unique ticker_id instead.

bid.description: Best executable bid; null when no open bid exists.

ask.description: Best executable ask (order book merged with open dispensers on BTC pairs); null when none.

is_stale.description: True when no completed settlement occurred within the last 90 days. Stale last prices remain visible and labeled; they are never replaced by open quotes.

target_volume.description: For dispenser executions this is protocol-priced notional (quantity x dispenser unit price), never the gross Bitcoin payment.

trade_timestamp.description: Unix SECONDS (per CoinGecko's spec for historical trades) - the Bitcoin block time of the settling block. Note the orderbook timestamp and ticker last_trade_timestamp are milliseconds.

source.description: Audit field: which settlement mechanism produced this fill.

settlement_txid.description: Audit field: the Bitcoin transaction that settled this fill, independently verifiable on-chain.

price_change_percent_24h.description: Percent, two decimals, versus the earliest completed fill inside the rolling window. "0.00" when the window is empty.

asset_url.description: Canonical explorer page; resolves symbol ambiguity.
